result.summary:
Fixed the @spec-vs-behavior mismatch TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR flagged. In lib/letflow/repository/activation.ex, Letflow.Repository.Activation.changeset/2 (used by both the insert and update branches of upsert_activation_pointer/8) now pipes through foreign_key_constraint(:active_version_id, name: :artifact_activations_active_version_id_fkey) -- the exact explicit FK-constraint name the migration (priv/repo/migrations/20260831000001_create_artifact_activations.exs) gives that FK. A real Postgres FK violation on active_version_id is now translated by Ecto into a changeset error instead of propagating as a raised Ecto.ConstraintError; format_activate_group_result/2's existing {:error, failed_step, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset, _changes} -> {:error, {:validation, changeset}} clause (already used for the group-envelope changeset failure path) now also handles this path, so activate_group/4's actual behavior matches its own @spec-documented {:error, {atom(), Ecto.Changeset.t()}} union.

Checked artifact_activation_history's own three FKs (previous_version_id, new_version_id both to artifact_versions; group_id to artifact_activation_groups) for the same gap and determined each is unreachable by construction within the same Ecto.Multi transaction, since Postgres FK constraints are checked IMMEDIATE (not DEFERRABLE) by default and this migration never opts into deferred checking: new_version_id is the identical version_id upsert_activation_pointer/8 already wrote (and had FK-validated) into active_version_id earlier in the same transaction (activation_step always runs before history_step in add_activation_steps/9); previous_version_id is read back from an existing, already-FK-validated artifact_activations row, and on_delete: :restrict means a referenced version can never later disappear; group_id is the group envelope row's own primary key, inserted as the Multi's :group step before any add_activation_steps/9 step runs, so a failure there aborts the whole transaction before insert_activation_history/12 is ever reached. Documented this reasoning as a code comment directly above insert_activation_history/12 in lib/letflow/repository/activation.ex rather than adding unreachable foreign_key_constraint/3 mappings to ActivationHistory.changeset/2.

Updated the one specific test TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR named: test/letflow/repository/activation_test.exs's 'AC1 -- atomic multi-artifact activation, forced-failure rollback' describe block's first test ('a version_id with no matching artifact_versions row rolls back the whole group...') now asserts {:error, {:validation, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset}} = Activation.activate_group(...) plus {"does not exist", _} = changeset.errors[:active_version_id], replacing the prior assert_raise Ecto.ConstraintError. Updated the test's own comment block to describe the fixed behavior instead of the defect. No other test in the file was touched. Did not touch the TEST-ONLY seam (activate_group/4 arity 4->5, test_pause_after/test_pause_fun, maybe_add_test_pause_step/3) per the routing instruction -- that is REVIEWER's separate concern in this same combined pass.
